funds.name: 綠色成長基金 Green Growth Fund

check_size.raw: NT$20 million – NT$100 million per company

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first government venture-capital mechanism embedded in environmental policy. The National Development Fund and Ministry of Environment co-invest with private capital across six net-zero domains — resource circulation, deep energy efficiency, forward-looking energy & energy storage, digital/low-carbon technology, carbon capture & negative-carbon technology, and climate-adaptation/disaster-prevention technology — to seed a domestic green-startup ecosystem over a 10-year horizon.

application.how_to_apply: Investments are made through matched private co-investors (創投/管理顧問) approved as Green Growth Fund partners, who source and propose targets; startups engage via these partner funds.

summary.en: A NT$10 billion (US$318M) government co-investment fund launched in 2024 by Taiwan's Ministry of Environment and National Development Fund — the country's first venture-capital mechanism built into environmental policy — channeling capital with private partners into six net-zero technology domains over 10 years.
summary.local: 由環境部與國家發展基金於 2024 年共同推動的百億元（新台幣 100 億元）綠色成長基金，是台灣首度將創投機制導入環保政策。透過搭配民間創投共同投資，10 年內鎖定資源循環、深度節能、前瞻能源與儲能、數位低碳、碳捕捉與負碳技術、氣候調適等六大淨零領域。

name.local: 國泰永續私募股權基金

current_fund.raw: approx. NT$10 billion target (新台幣100億元)

funds.name: 國泰永續私募股權基金 (Cathay Sustainability PE Fund)

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first domestic private-equity fund dedicated to sustainability, established by Cathay SITE (a Cathay Financial Holdings subsidiary) and the first PE fund approved by the FSC for a Taiwanese SITE. Invests 100% in Taiwan's sustainable industries — circular economy, green energy technology (notably solar and water resource treatment/recycling) and other priority sectors — using a limited-partnership structure for long-term, steady-return projects with high industry barriers.

notable_investments.company: Green Rock Energy (綠岩能源) energy-storage platform

summary.en: Taiwan's first sustainability-dedicated private-equity fund, set up by Cathay SITE (Cathay Financial Holdings) and approved by the FSC. Targeting roughly NT$10 billion, it invests entirely in Taiwan's circular economy, green-energy and water-resource sectors, and in 2023 co-built an energy-storage investment platform with Green Rock Energy.
summary.local: 國內首檔鎖定永續產業的私募股權基金，由國泰投信（國泰金控子公司）籌設，為金管會核准之首檔由投信設立的 PE Fund。目標規模約新台幣 100 億元，100% 投資台灣循環經濟、綠能科技（太陽能、水資源處理回收）等產業，2023 年並與綠岩能源合組儲能投資平台。

Strictly a PE/growth vehicle (not early-stage VC) but squarely climate/sustainability-focused, hence included.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Delta Electronics, a global power and thermal-management leader whose mission is 'to provide innovative, clean and energy-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow.' Focuses on growth-equity and minority investments in late-stage and middle-market energy, technology and healthcare companies aligned with Delta's core strengths in power electronics and energy efficiency.

summary.en: The corporate venture / investment arm of Taiwan-based Delta Electronics, a global leader in power and thermal management. It makes growth-equity and minority investments — typically $10M–$50M deals — in late-stage energy, technology and healthcare companies aligned with Delta's clean and energy-efficient mission.
summary.local: 台達電子（全球電源與散熱管理大廠）的企業創投／投資部門。以成長期股權及少數股權方式投資能源、科技與醫療領域的後期企業，單筆交易多落在 1,000 萬至 5,000 萬美元，投資方向呼應台達『提供創新、潔淨、節能解決方案』的使命。

program.eligibility: Taiwanese startups and SMEs developing carbon-reduction solutions, especially for high-emission sectors (electronics, energy, steel)

strategy.thesis: National green-tech accelerator run by ITRI's Commercialization and Industry Service Center. Bridges the carbon-reduction knowledge gap for Taiwanese startups and SMEs and connects them with listed enterprises and overseas markets to co-create sustainable green business models, targeting high-emission sectors such as electronics, energy and steel.

summary.en: A national green-tech accelerator spearheaded by ITRI's Commercialization and Industry Service Center (formerly 'Green Accelerator,' rebranded 2025). It runs a roughly six-month incubation, in 2024 propelling 10 Taiwanese startups in areas like water management, renewable energy, circular economy and eco-materials into ties with listed companies and MENA/SE-Asia markets.
summary.local: 由工研院產業服務中心主導的國家級綠色科技加速器（原名 Green Accelerator，2025 年更名 Green Tech Accelerator）。約六個月的育成期，2024 年帶領 10 家台灣新創（涵蓋水資源管理、再生能源、循環經濟、環保材料等）對接上市櫃企業與中東、東南亞市場，鎖定電子、能源、鋼鐵等高碳排產業。

strategy.thesis: A venture fund investing in global early-stage climate-technology companies, combining institutional discipline with deep operator networks and Asia-Pacific supply-chain access. Investments span clean energy, green chemistry, circular economy, sustainable food & agriculture, and climate adaptation, leveraging Taiwan's manufacturing and distribution infrastructure to scale climate-tech.

summary.en: A Taiwan-established early-stage climate-tech venture fund founded by serial entrepreneur Lawrence Yen, investing globally in clean energy, green chemistry, circular economy, sustainable food/agriculture and climate adaptation. It positions Taiwan's manufacturing and Asia-Pacific supply-chain access as its differentiator for scaling climate technologies.
summary.local: 由連續創業家 Lawrence Yen 創立、設於台灣的早期氣候科技創投基金，投資範圍涵蓋潔淨能源、綠色化學、循環經濟、永續食農與氣候調適。以台灣製造實力與亞太供應鏈網絡作為協助氣候科技公司放大規模的差異化優勢。

strategy.thesis: Cross-Pacific venture firm investing at early and early-expansion stage across Taiwan, Silicon Valley and Greater China. Its three core focus areas are technology (TMT), clean technology and healthcare; cleantech has long been one of its named investment pillars.

summary.en: A cross-Pacific venture firm founded in 1993 with offices in Taipei, San Francisco and Beijing, managing 9 funds and over $1B. It backs early and expansion-stage companies in technology, clean technology and healthcare — cleantech being one of its three named pillars — with 300+ investments and 80+ exits.
summary.local: 1993 年成立的跨太平洋創投，於台北、舊金山、北京設有辦公室，管理 9 檔基金、逾 10 億美元資金。投資早期至擴張期企業，鎖定科技（TMT）、潔淨科技與醫療三大領域，潔淨科技為其長期投資主軸之一；累計逾 300 件投資、80 餘件出場。

aka: 能率亞洲資本股份有限公司

current_fund.raw: NT$1.675 billion (current capital / 實收資本)

strategy.thesis: A Taiwan-Japan venture capital firm backing growth-stage and transformation-themed Taiwanese enterprises across high-tech, aerospace, new-energy vehicles, biotech/medical devices, consumer and traditional industries. Selected by the Ministry of Environment as a matched co-investment partner for strengthening Taiwan's green/environmental industries under the Green Growth Fund.

summary.en: A Taipei-based Taiwan-Japan VC founded in 2015 with NT$1.675 billion in capital, investing in growth-stage and transformation-themed enterprises (high-tech, aerospace, new-energy vehicles, biotech). It was selected by Taiwan's Ministry of Environment as a Green Growth Fund matched co-investment partner, giving it a green/sustainability mandate alongside its broader portfolio.
summary.local: 2015 年成立、總部位於台北的台日創投，實收資本約新台幣 16.75 億元，投資成長期與轉型題材企業（高科技、航太、新能源車、生技醫材等）。獲環境部評選為綠色成長基金搭配投資單位，因而具備綠色／永續產業投資任務。
